keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Augsburg 1, Schalke 04 0. Michael Gregoritsch (Augsburg) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Anton Kade.
Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Second Half begins Augsburg 1, Schalke 04 0.
Substitution, Schalke 04. Robin Gosens replaces Vitalie Becker.
Substitution, Schalke 04. Max Wöber replaces Hasan Kuruçay.
Substitution, Schalke 04. Junior Dina Ebimbe replaces Junior Adamu.
Ron Schallenberg (Schalke 04) is shown the red card.
Substitution, Augsburg. Mert Kömür replaces Robin Fellhauer.
Substitution, Schalke 04. Edin Dzeko replaces Nikola Katic.
Goal! Augsburg 2, Schalke 04 0. Anton Kade (Augsburg) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Fabian Rieder following a fast break.
Substitution, Augsburg. Rodrigo Ribeiro replaces Michael Gregoritsch.
Substitution, Augsburg. Yannik Keitel replaces Fabian Rieder.
Substitution, Schalke 04. Mertcan Ayhan replaces Adil Aouchiche.
Delay in match because of an injury Calvin Brackelmann (Augsburg).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Augsburg. Jeffrey Gouweleeuw replaces Calvin Brackelmann because of an injury.
Substitution, Augsburg. Seol Young-Woo replaces Marius Wolf.
Goal! Augsburg 3, Schalke 04 0. Rodrigo Ribeiro (Augsburg) right footed shot from a difficult angle on the right to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Seol Young-Woo.
Second Half ends, Augsburg 3, Schalke 04 0.
